WITH web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(ws_sales_price) AS web_daily_sales,
           COUNT(*) AS web_daily_n
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim
      ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    WHERE ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk, d_date
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(ss_sales_price) AS store_daily_sales,
           COUNT(*) AS store_daily_n
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim
      ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    WHERE ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, d_date
),
timeline AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(web_daily_sales) AS web_daily_sales,
           SUM(store_daily_sales) AS store_daily_sales,
           SUM(web_daily_n) AS web_daily_n,
           SUM(store_daily_n) AS store_daily_n
    FROM (
        SELECT item_sk,
               d_date,
               web_daily_sales,
               NULL AS store_daily_sales,
               web_daily_n,
               0 AS store_daily_n
        FROM web_daily
        UNION ALL
        SELECT item_sk,
               d_date,
               NULL AS web_daily_sales,
               store_daily_sales,
               0 AS web_daily_n,
               store_daily_n
        FROM store_daily
    ) AS daily_rows
    GROUP BY item_sk, d_date
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(web_daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           SUM(store_daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative,
           web_daily_n,
           store_daily_n
    FROM timeline
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       CASE WHEN web_daily_n > 0 THEN web_cumulative END AS web_sales,
       CASE WHEN store_daily_n > 0 THEN store_cumulative END AS store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM cumulative
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
